- Fixed automatic compaction reusing the session's earlier system prompt instead of rebuilding it the way `/compact` does
- Fixed markdown rendering freezing on some very long or malformed input
- Fixed rare screen freezes
- Fixed Esc often being lost at a permission prompt or question when you typed straight after it; in terminals that send Alt as Esc and a key, an unused Alt or Option key now declines there
- Fixed a paste or a terminal's reply being typed into the prompt when a slow connection cut it in two
- Fixed saving a scheduled task erasing the project's other saved tasks when the scheduled tasks file can't be read, on third-party providers or with telemetry or feature flags turned off
- Fixed a scheduled task with a typo in the project's scheduled tasks file being deleted the next time that file was saved
- Fixed a case where a resumed cloud session could lose its compaction summary or recent messages when a message was saved late
- Fixed the token counts on the spinner and for subagents counting a retried reply twice, missing replies that were not streamed, and standing still while Claude thinks
- Fixed the error shown when usage credits run out mid-response, which named a rate limit
- Fixed auto mode failing every turn outside Claude Desktop with `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_BETAS` set behind a gateway rejecting betas, on Bedrock, Agent Platform, Foundry or Claude apps gateway
- Fixed `CLAUDE_STREAM_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS` not lengthening the 5-minute connection limit on gateways, custom base URLs and cloud providers
- Fixed some Claude Desktop sessions on third-party providers, other than scheduled tasks, ending for good with "Prompt is too long" after large tool results; the largest are now left out
- Fixed MCP tools whose input schema starts with `anyOf`, `oneOf` or `allOf` going missing on third-party providers or with telemetry or feature flags turned off
- Fixed an MCP tool with an invalid input schema failing requests on third-party providers or with telemetry or feature flags turned off; the tool is now left out and Claude is told why
- Fixed effort being turned off for a subagent's model for the session if Bedrock, Google Cloud's Agent Platform or Foundry refused its progress summary's effort setting (regression in 2.1.327)
- Fixed Code Mode stopping a script when a permission prompt outside auto or bypass mode, a plan approval or a question stayed open for ten minutes
- Fixed Code Mode scripts in auto and bypass-permissions modes failing to call an MCP server that had connected while the previous script was running
- Fixed Code Mode scripts not running in the background in auto or bypass permissions mode in a session chosen in the `claude --resume` picker
- Fixed Code Mode losing a loaded skill, hook context or a note typed with a permission approval when resuming a session in which one reply ran several scripts
- Fixed Claude not being told that a Code Mode script was cut off when the session was resumed from the picker or in a mode that asks for permission
- Fixed Code Mode silently using `undefined` for top-level variables that an earlier failed script never set
- Fixed Code Mode scripts not being told when a failing command's long output was cut
- Fixed Code Mode refusing valid scripts that start with a `{` block
- Fixed Code Mode refusing scripts that use both a top-level `await` and a top-level `return`
- Fixed an @-mentioned small file not being attached in Code Mode after a script had read or written it
- Fixed Code Mode offering `write()` and `edit()` to read-only subagents that can't call them
- Fixed Claude starting a turn by itself in Code Mode when Esc was followed by a command such as `/model`
- Fixed Claude in Code Mode not being told to run workflows only when you ask, or the workflow size you set in `/config`
- Fixed Remote Control repeating the same disconnect message, and telling you to retry a session that can't reconnect
- Fixed a waiting permission prompt being lost, and its answer ignored, when a remote session restarted while the service was slow
- Fixed cloud sessions resuming a cleared conversation after a rewind followed by `/clear`
- Fixed a remote session losing a turn's tool calls and results when its runner or worker was lost after a dropped model stream had been retried
- Fixed cloud and Remote Control sessions that just started, or have an @ in their title, being unreachable in cross-session messaging from a session with Remote Control on
- Fixed Claude being told that cloud sessions can never reply; it now learns when a reply can come and how else to get the result
- Fixed `/diff`, the Changes pane of Remote Control sessions and the diff beside an edit leaving out committed work after a command moved into another repository
- Fixed Remote Control not showing a running workflow's agents when a session run by an IDE extension or other SDK app is opened over an hour after the workflow last made progress
- Remote Control: Fixed an idle Desktop or VS Code session showing as running after Remote Control is turned on
- Fixed the model saying background agents were still running after an SDK interrupt had stopped them
- Fixed Send now in the desktop app and SDK hosts telling Claude that a stopped web search found no results
- Fixed Cmd+letter being typed into the prompt in terminals that report Cmd
- Fixed Ctrl+click opening a link twice in GNOME Terminal, side mouse buttons acting as clicks, and the first wheel notch in the other direction being ignored after a pause, in fullscreen mode
- Fixed Shift+Enter in Konsole outside tmux and ssh, and Alt shortcuts on non-Latin keyboard layouts in terminals that speak the kitty keyboard protocol
- Linux: Fixed pasting in other apps freezing while Claude Code is suspended with Ctrl+Z, when `xclip` or `wl-copy` is installed
- Linux: Fixed Ctrl+V missing the clipboard image, pasting an old one or hanging
- Fixed text copied in fullscreen mode including the quote bar, losing spaces at line wraps when a drag scrolled upward, or missing words under the "Jump to bottom" pill
- Fixed an image path pasted into a `!` command becoming an attachment
- Fixed Ctrl+C showing no exit warning while the `?` shortcuts list is open
- Fixed Ctrl+R search in fullscreen mode and the `/theme` color editor picking the wrong row when keys arrive together, and keys being dropped there and in the search of `/config` and `/plugin`
- Fixed wrong or missing colors inside GNU screen
- Fixed many background notifications cutting into the top border of open dialogs in fullscreen mode
- Fixed a message to a background agent showing a long file path in place of a pasted image
- Fixed `/goal` removing a skill's Stop hook, or ending early on another hook's result, when both had the same wording
- Fixed `/bug` saying cancelled after the report was sent
- Fixed Esc not dismissing the transcript share question for Pro and Max users
- Fixed `/hooks` losing your place when going back
- Fixed `/export` writing a file named `.txt` when the name was left empty
- Fixed `/terminal-setup` in Zed replacing a symlinked `keymap.json` with a plain file
- Fixed `/install-github-app` adding a code review workflow when asked to update the existing workflow file
- Fixed `/plugin` reopening a skill, or closing the open page, when a slow save or removal finished after you went back
- Fixed `/plugin` asking to uninstall the wrong plugin, or ignoring Esc, after leaving a plugin while a change was still running
- Fixed typing and arrow keys not working on the `/plugin` Installed tab after a search with no results or a click on the tab row
- Fixed holding Enter in `/plugin` turning off several installed plugins
- Fixed the `/usage` plugin total stopping at 2,000 tokens on 1M context models, and low token estimates in `/usage` and `/plugin` when no model is picked
- Fixed Esc on the Bedrock access keys step closing `/login` instead of going back
- Fixed `/exit` and Ctrl+D describing running work differently, and `/exit` warning about a workflow that had stopped
- Fixed Claude calling an artifact private after reading one in a shared folder or publishing to another organization's, and saying only named people can open one when its folder's people can too
- Fixed a plugin's toast sometimes showing another plugin's text
- Fixed a mod saved just after a turn began sometimes reloading mid-turn instead of at the turn's end
- Fixed one malformed `OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES` entry dropping the variable's other labels from metric points, events, and spans. Now only that entry is left off
- Fixed agent hooks running past their timeout while compacting after a request was refused as too large
- Fixed a crash at startup when `FORCE_COLOR` is set to a negative number
- Fixed a crash in secret masking when the machine is almost out of memory
- Fixed the Bash sandbox on Linux renaming `.git/HEAD` after each command when the branch name is not valid UTF-8
- Self-hosted runner: Fixed all running sessions being stopped when a proxy or web filter answered a poll with HTTP 200 and a body such as `{}`; the runner now retries such a poll
- Self-hosted runner: Fixed deletion of a kept clone's objects or refs, and of commits that existed only there, after a temporary disk error; that start now fails instead
- Fixed self-hosted runners stopping when their token ran out on a host whose clock is slow or was set back
- Self-hosted runner: Fixed sessions with Anthropic-managed git losing git access to GitHub after a script or hook in the session ran `claude` again
- Fixed self-hosted runners with Anthropic-managed git being unable to fetch or push where the machine's git config sets `http.proactiveAuth`
- Self-hosted runner: Fixed a runner that exited without telling the server when setup failed after it had registered; it now deregisters with a reason, and an on-demand runner reports the failed start
- Self-hosted runner: Fixed archiving or requeueing a session not taking effect while it waited for another session to prepare the same repository (`--capacity` above 1)
- Self-hosted runner: Fixed a session with a damaged `.claude.json` failing every later start under `--trust-workspace false`; it now starts on defaults, with MCP servers turned off there on again
- Self-hosted runner: Fixed a failed start's message losing the words that say what failed when a checkout hook or git printed a lot
- Fixed the self-hosted runner skipping its post-session hook when a disk stalled for a few seconds; on a dead disk a session's end can take 25 seconds longer by default
- Fixed self-hosted runners: a session that resumes in a new Claude config directory no longer loses its task list
- Fixed Claude not being told when a self-hosted session starts without one of its repositories, and why
- Self-hosted runner: Fixed `--correlation-id` of `claude --environment` not reaching the `spawn-runner` hook
- Fixed the self-hosted runner setup wizard's key rotation advice, which now warns that revoking a key stops the sessions running under it
- Improved `claude -p` and SDK sessions to fetch managed-settings plugins that have their own git repository, in the background, for a later session
- Improved how soon managed-settings plugins from a git marketplace load on a fresh machine in `claude -p`, SDK and Claude Desktop sessions; a short run may exit up to 30 seconds later
- Improved the time to resume large sessions
- Improved memory use when resuming a session with many images
- Improved memory use and response time in long SDK and desktop sessions that run slow commands or tools
- Improved Code Mode's speed in auto and bypass-permissions modes by removing a 0.75 second pause after most scripts
- Improved prompt caching for new Code Mode sessions that have MCP servers, and Claude is now told when a server is still connecting and when the list of servers changes
- Improved Code Mode's token use with shorter tool descriptions
- Improved Code Mode to show the command a script is running, and its output, while it runs
- Improved Code Mode edits: an edit that changes nothing no longer stops a script, and Claude is told where a failed edit matches or comes closest
- Improved Code Mode: Claude is now told which tool calls were still running when a script failed
- Improved how Claude starts dev servers in Code Mode's auto and bypass modes: Claude is told to run them as background tasks that show in `/tasks`
- Windows: Improved Code Mode by telling Claude that scripts' shell commands run in Git Bash and that PowerShell aliases run instead of functions with the same name
- Improved starting several in-process teammates at once: far fewer now fail with "Lock file is already being held"
- Improved the computer use approval dialog: it now shows each app's level of access and plainer warnings
- Improved cross-session messaging: Claude now explains that Remote Control is off when a cloud session or another computer is not listed
- Improved `claude -p` text output to say on stderr when a message from another session is held or dropped, and how to allow it
- Improved Claude's answers on who can open an artifact it published: Claude is now told to check the artifact again instead of repeating the last publish's answer
- Improved resumed self-hosted runner sessions: Claude now checks whether its earlier work is still there, and says what is missing
- Changed plan mode and Bash prompts for Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6 on third-party providers to use and offer auto mode, as on newer models; `disableAutoMode` turns both off
- Changed Code Mode to no longer run UserPromptSubmit hooks, managed ones included, on scripts' output; to redact that output, use a PostToolUse hook with `updatedToolOutput`
- Changed `/code-review` on most models to report only bugs and CLAUDE.md violations; run `/simplify` for reuse, simplification and efficiency cleanups
- Changed `/code-review` to mark each finding Important, Pre-existing or Nit on most models, and to end each summary with a suggested fix; a clean review's list now reads "Code review found no issues."
- Changed `deniedMcpServers` entries of the form `claude.ai <name>` to apply to that connector in cloud and self-hosted runner sessions too
- Changed managed `PostToolUse` hooks to no longer fire for calls refused before they ran: no log entry, rewrite, block or stop there; `PostToolBatch` gets most, not marked as refused
- Changed `/bug` to ask Yes or No before sending, so repeated Enters no longer send a report or open GitHub
- Changed subagents in `claude -p`, the Agent SDK, desktop and VS Code to wait for their own subagents by default when `CLAUDE_CODE_FORK_SUBAGENT=0` is set
- Changed `claude -p` with `CLAUDE_CODE_FORK_SUBAGENT=0` to count a background subagent and those it waits for against one 10-minute wait; raise `CLAUDE_CODE_PRINT_BG_WAIT_CEILING_MS` for longer chains
- Changed a shell command rewritten by a PermissionRequest hook to a sandbox-excluded command to run outside the sandbox
- Changed the Claude in Chrome welcome screen and `/chrome` to say that Claude Code asks before Claude acts on a site, unless your permission mode or a rule in `/permissions` answers
- Changed Claude Desktop and Agent SDK sessions on third-party providers or with telemetry or feature flags off to end the turn when closed with a question open, instead of continuing without an answer
- Changed pasted text to be marked for Claude as pasted, on third-party providers or with telemetry or feature flags turned off
- Changed subagent progress summaries in terminal sessions on the Anthropic API to be written by the default small fast model from short notes, also with telemetry off, using far fewer tokens
- Changed how a sandbox that can't start is reported, unless `sandbox.failIfUnavailable` is set: the next sandboxed Bash command is refused and says that the sandbox is off for the session
- Changed `/list-agents` to show its list to you alone; Claude lists sessions itself when needed
- Self-hosted runner: Changed the built-in `gh api` to be off by default where settings guard Claude's GitHub tools by name; `--use-anthropic-gh true` turns it on
- Self-hosted runner: Changed a `claude` that a wrapper script runs before the session's own `claude` is up, or after it has ended, to have no Anthropic-managed git
- Self-hosted runner: Changed `CLAUDE_RUNNER_SESSION_UUID` and `CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE_SESSION_UUID` to both be set for the session and its `checkout`, `post-session` and `spawn-runner` hooks
- Changed self-hosted runners at `--capacity 1` to refuse a session earlier when the path of a repository it pushes to is a symbolic link
- [VSCode] Added a notice when a message from another session is held, with a link to the settings file that can allow it
- [VSCode] Fixed the permission prompt cutting off its No button, reply field or title when the panel is low or a command, URL or description is long
- [VSCode] Fixed failed or blocked tool calls showing no reason or a reason cut short, and Glob and Grep counting an error as results

- Changed `/code-review` on most models to report only bugs and CLAUDE.md violations; run `/simplify` for reuse, simplification and efficiency cleanups
- Changed `/code-review` to mark each finding Important, Pre-existing or Nit on most models, and to end each summary with a suggested fix; a clean review's list now reads "Code review found no issues."
- Changed `deniedMcpServers` entries of the form `claude.ai <name>` to apply to that connector in cloud and self-hosted runner sessions too
- Changed managed `PostToolUse` hooks to no longer fire for calls refused before they ran: no log entry, rewrite, block or stop there; `PostToolBatch` gets most, not marked as refused
- Changed `/bug` to ask Yes or No before sending, so repeated Enters no longer send a report or open GitHub
- Changed subagents in `claude -p`, the Agent SDK, desktop and VS Code to wait for their own subagents by default when `CLAUDE_CODE_FORK_SUBAGENT=0` is set
- Changed `claude -p` with `CLAUDE_CODE_FORK_SUBAGENT=0` to count a background subagent and those it waits for against one 10-minute wait; raise `CLAUDE_CODE_PRINT_BG_WAIT_CEILING_MS` for longer chains
- Changed a shell command rewritten by a PermissionRequest hook to a sandbox-excluded command to run outside the sandbox
- Changed the Claude in Chrome welcome screen and `/chrome` to say that Claude Code asks before Claude acts on a site, unless your permission mode or a rule in `/permissions` answers
- Changed Claude Desktop and Agent SDK sessions on third-party providers or with telemetry or feature flags off to end the turn when closed with a question open, instead of continuing without an answer
- Changed pasted text to be marked for Claude as pasted, on third-party providers or with telemetry or feature flags turned off
- Changed subagent progress summaries in terminal sessions on the Anthropic API to be written by the default small fast model from short notes, also with telemetry off, using far fewer tokens
- Changed how a sandbox that can't start is reported, unless `sandbox.failIfUnavailable` is set: the next sandboxed Bash command is refused and says that the sandbox is off for the session
- Changed `/list-agents` to show its list to you alone; Claude lists sessions itself when needed
- Self-hosted runner: Changed the built-in `gh api` to be off by default where settings guard Claude's GitHub tools by name; `--use-anthropic-gh true` turns it on
- Self-hosted runner: Changed a `claude` that a wrapper script runs before the session's own `claude` is up, or after it has ended, to have no Anthropic-managed git
- Self-hosted runner: Changed `CLAUDE_RUNNER_SESSION_UUID` and `CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE_SESSION_UUID` to both be set for the session and its `checkout`, `post-session` and `spawn-runner` hooks
- Changed self-hosted runners at `--capacity 1` to refuse a session earlier when the path of a repository it pushes to is a symbolic link
- [VSCode] Added a notice when a message from another session is held, with a link to the settings file that can allow it
- [VSCode] Fixed the permission prompt cutting off its No button, reply field or title when the panel is low or a command, URL or description is long
- [VSCode] Fixed failed or blocked tool calls showing no reason or a reason cut short, and Glob and Grep counting an error as results

# Patch release v5.24.1

A patch to fix a bunch of stuff for vLLM, a few distributed issues, and some model fixes (llama4, dory); see the full list

### vLLM related
- Fix backward compatibility of the cache rename for remote code (#51085) by @hmellor
- Restore modeling_attn_mask_utils for remote code (one-off to unblock vLLM) (#51124) by @hmellor 
- Expose past_key_values in MBartDecoderLayer.forward signature for remote code (#51177) by @hmellor 
- [OmniASR] Support a padding_mask kept on the CPU in the audio encoder (#51100) by @El-euchidali

### Model fixes
- Fix Llama4 forward crash on missing image_outputs (#51144) by @kylesayrs
- Fix dory static cache (#50993) by @ArthurZucker 

### Distributed
- Allow expert parallelism alone with tp_plan={} (#50996) by @3outeille 
- Fix strided checkpoint reads on PyTorch 2.9 (#51042) by @satsuki2486441738

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/compare/v5.24.0...v5.24.1

rawIngestions.titleRaw: huggingface/transformers v5.24.0 released
rawIngestions.contentRaw: # Release v5.24.0 ## New Model additions ### Inkling 2 Mini Inkling 2 Mini is a multimodal model from Thinking Machines Lab that accepts text and image inputs and generates text outputs. It is a smaller sibling of Inkling 2 Small, added in v5.23.0. It has 24 decoder layers instead of 48, and compensates with a looping mechanism in which layers 6 to 17 run three times. A learned message-passing mechanism mixes the residuals of the previous pass into the attention and mixture-of-experts inputs of each loop layer. The decoder has a hidden size of 2304 and routes each token to 8 of 128 experts. The image encoder, tokenizer and processor are the same as Inkling 2 Small's. A research checkpoint ([TML-d24-varloop-research](https://huggingface.co/thinkingmachines/TML-d24-varloop-research)) has the same architecture but supports a variable number of loop passes. Fewer passes are faster, and more passes improve quality. Both checkpoints contain NVFP4 and MXFP8 quantized layers, which are dequantized at load time. **Links:** [Documentation](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/inkling2_loop) | [Blog Post](https://thinkingmachines.ai/news/inkling-2-mini/) | [HF Blog Post](https://huggingface.co/blog/inkling2mini) * Add Inkling2 Mini (#51050) by @guarin ### Apertus 1.5 Apertus 1.5 is a multimodal model from the Swiss AI Initiative that accepts text, images and audio and generates text. It extends the Apertus language model with the EMU3.5 vision tokenizer for images and WavTokenizer for audio. The EMU3.5 tokenizer is an image-only VQGAN with the same encoder as Chameleon's, and it assigns codes by the largest inner product with the codebook. The media tokenizers turn images and audio into discrete tokens, which the language backbone processes alongside text in a shared input vocabulary. The output vocabulary contains only text tokens, so image and audio generation are not supported. **Links:** [Documentation](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/apertus1p5) * Apertus 1.5: add model (#47662) by @RaphaelKreft ### WavTokenizer WavTokenizer encodes 24 kHz mono audio into discrete tokens using a single codebook, at 40 or 75 tokens per second depending on the checkpoint, and reconstructs audio from those tokens. `WavTokenizerModel` encodes and decodes, and `WavTokenizerEncoderModel` only encodes. Speech, music/audio and unified checkpoints are available. The 40-token-per-second variant is the audio tokenizer of Apertus 1.5. Training the codec is not supported. **Links:** [Documentation](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/wavtokenizer) | [Paper](https://huggingface.co/papers/2408.16532) * Apertus 1.5: add model (#47662) by @RaphaelKreft ### Dory Dory is a looped (latent-recurrent) language model from NVIDIA. It uses a normalized-GPT architecture with interleaved sliding-window and full attention layers. A shared block of layers is applied repeatedly, so Dory can spend more compute per token. The loop count can be changed at inference time on the same checkpoint to trade speed against quality. **Links:** [Documentation](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/dory) | [Paper (nGPT)](https://huggingface.co/papers/2410.01131) * Add Dory model support (#50099) by @shan18 ### HY4-VL HY4-VL (Hunyuan V4 Vision-Language) combines the HYV4 mixture-of-experts text backbone with a vision encoder for image-text and video-text generation. It supports dynamic-resolution visual inputs and uses multimodal rotary position embeddings (mRoPE) to represent temporal and spatial positions. It builds on the Qwen2-VL design and shares its vision patch merger with HunYuan-VL. **Links:** [Documentation](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/hy_v4_vl) * Add HY4-VL (#50877) by @vasqu ### Omnilingual ASR Omnilingual ASR is a suite of multilingual speech-recognition models from Meta FAIR that covers more than 1,600 languages. Each model pairs a Wav2Vec2-style audio encoder with one of two heads: * **CTC** (`OmniASRForCTC`): a linear projection to the vocabulary, decoded non-autoregressively with greedy CTC. * **Audio language model** (`OmniASRForConditionalGeneration`): audio embeddings are projected into a Llama decoder that generates the transcription. It optionally takes a language code (e.g. `"eng_Latn"`), which generally improves transcription quality. Both variants come in 300M, 1B, 3B and 7B sizes. **Links:** [Documentation](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/omniasr) | [CTC Documentation](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/omniasr_ctc) | [Paper](https://huggingface.co/papers/2511.09690) * Adding Omnilingual ASR models (#43265) by @ebezzam ### Lara Mini Lara Mini is a multilingual base language model from Translated with 7.2B total and 0.6B active parameters per token. It is a hybrid of linear-time recurrent layers, sliding-window attention and a few global attention layers, each followed by a fine-grained mixture of experts. The weights are released under the CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 license (non-commercial use) in a gated repository. **Links:** [Documentation](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/lara_mini) | [Paper](https://huggingface.co/papers/2611.16956) * Add Lara Mini (#50819) by @ValeGian ### SarvamMLA SarvamMLA is the architecture of Sarvam-105B, a 105B-parameter mixture-of-experts language model from Sarvam AI. It combines Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA) with sparse MoE routing: 128 routed experts with 8 active per token, plus 1 shared expert. It uses sigmoid routing with group-based top-k selection and YaRN rotary embeddings for contexts up to 131K tokens. The architecture is the same as DeepSeek-V3, with a custom configuration. **Links:** [Documentation](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/sarvam_mla) * Add SarvamMLA model (sarvamai/sarvam-105b) (#44569) by @aashay-sarvam ### SarvamMoE SarvamMoE is the architecture of Sarvam-30B, Sarvam AI's 30B-parameter mixture-of-experts model. It uses grouped-query attention with QK normalization, and 128 routed experts with 6 active per token, plus 1 shared expert. The architecture is the same as GLM-4-MoE, so the auto classes load it with the GLM-4-MoE implementation and only `SarvamMoEConfig` is specific to SarvamMoE. **Links:** [Documentation](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/sarvam_moe) * Add SarvamMoE (sarvamai/sarvam-30b) (#51023) by @hmellor ### EXAONE EXAONE covers the EXAONE 3.0, EXAONE 3.5 and EXAONE Deep language models from LG AI Research. Their architecture is the same as Llama, so the auto classes load them with `LlamaModel` and `LlamaForCausalLM`, and only `ExaoneConfig` is specific to EXAONE. The released checkpoints are renamed to the Llama names when loading and back when saving, so they no longer need `trust_remote_code=True`. **Links:** [Documentation](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/exaone) * Add EXAONE (#50966) by @hmellor ### Model updates * **Ling 3.1 Flash** now loads natively through `BailingHybrid`, like Ling 3.0 in v5.20.0 (#49737) by @icavan * **Beam** gains a `BeamForTokenClassification` head (#50634) by @AymenKallala ## Breaking changes ### Cache renaming: `past_key_values` / `cache_params` → `cache` (#50585, #50730) `past_key_values` and `cache_params` are renamed to `cache` across the library. The old names still work with a deprecation warning; see the dedicated section below. * 🚨🚨 Rename `past_key_values`/`cache_params` to `cache` (#50585) by @Cyrilvallez * Bump minimal peft version for cache name compatibility (#50730) by @Cyrilvallez Attention models used to call their cache `past_key_values`, while Mamba-style and linear-attention models called it `cache_params`. Hybrid models therefore had to juggle two names for the same object. There is now a single name, `cache`, everywhere: model `forward` signatures, `generate`, `prepare_inputs_for_generation`, the masking utilities, and every `ModelOutput`. ```python # Before outputs = model(input_ids, past_key_values=past_key_values, use_cache=True) next_cache = outputs.past_key_values # Now outputs = model(input_ids, cache=cache, use_cache=True) next_cache = outputs.cache ``` * **Fully backward compatible for now**: `past_key_values=` / `cache_params=` are renamed to `cache` automatically, with a one-time deprecation warning. Model `forward` and `prepare_inputs_for_generation` accept the old names until **v5.40.0**, and `generate` accepts them until **v6.0.0**. Passing both an old name and `cache` raises a `ValueError`. * **Outputs too**: `outputs.past_key_values`, `outputs.cache_params` and `outputs["past_key_values"]` still return the cache. Output classes can also still be built with the old field names (e.g. `CausalLMOutputWithPast(past_key_values=...)`), so most remote-code models keep working unchanged. * **Custom code**: models defined outside the library should rename their arguments to `cache`. Layers now call `cache.update(key_states, value_states, layer_idx, kwargs=kwargs)`, so custom `Cache` subclasses that override `update` should accept the extra `kwargs` argument. 🚨 `peft>=0.22.0` is now required. 📚 Docs: ### Multimodal Outputs Generative multimodal models now return shared output classes (`MultimodalBaseModelOutputWithPast`, `MultimodalCausalLMOutputWithPast`, and their MoE variants) instead of one output class per model. Code that checks for a model-specific output class should switch to these. * 🚨 Multimodal Model Output for generative LMs (#50379) by @zucchini-nlp `modeling_attn_mask_utils.py` has been removed. Every function in it had been deprecated in favor of `transformers.masking_utils`. Remote-code models that still import `_prepare_4d_causal_attention_mask` or `AttentionMaskConverter` from it must move to `transformers.masking_utils`. ### Other things * Remove deprecated and unused older mask API file (#50728) by @Cyrilvallez LayoutLMv3 (and the PP-DocLayoutV2 reading-order model that shares its code) now go through the attention interface, so SDPA and flex attention are supported. The relative position bias is built once per forward pass and passed to attention as `position_bias`. * 🚨 LayoutLMv3: support SDPA through the attention interface, build the relative position bias once (#50688) by @14H034160212 ## Cache Beyond the rename, this release adds static-cache support to assisted decoding and fixes `generate` with flex attention and a static cache. `StaticCache` now allocates values with the value states' dtype, and the cache is kept under activation checkpointing when gradients are off. The `is_linear` / `is_croppable` properties are fixed for hybrid linear/full-attention models, BigBird block-sparse decoding works with a KV cache, and KV sharing is restored for the Gemma 4 assistants. * Support static cache in assisted decoding (#49415) by @jiqing-feng * Simplify cache handling in generate (#50910) by @Cyrilvallez * Fix generate with flex attention and a static cache (#50864) by @tarekziade * Allocate the StaticCache values with the value states' dtype (#49554) by @qgallouedec * Keep the cache under activation checkpointing when gradients are off (#50890) by @qgallouedec * [cache] Fix is_linear property to correctly remove hybrid layers (#51030) by @Cyrilvallez * Fix is_croppable property for mixed linear-full attention classes (#51028) by @Cyrilvallez * Fix BigBird block-sparse decoding with a KV cache (#49984) by @jiqing-feng * fix(gemma4): Restore KV sharing for the Gemma 4 assistants and their targets (#50531) by @harshaljanjani * Fix Dory vocabulary resizing, loop validation, and last-loop static caching (#50982) by @shan18 * Fix device placement in `test_bc_cache_name_{forward,generate}` (#50757) by @ydshieh * Update test_dynamic_cache_hard expected values for A10G (#50822) by @ydshieh ## Generation Generation fixes cover sampled beam search (candidates are sorted again before finalization), constrained sampling (batch IDs are preserved), `generate` on MPS with encoder-decoder models, and `TextStreamer`, which no longer drops spaces or lags on text without spaces such as Chinese, Japanese and Korean. `StopStringCriteria` initializes faster, and its cache now actually hits. * Restore sorting of sampled beam candidates before finalization (#50754) by @BlazeSR10hawk * fix(generate): preserve batch IDs in constrained sampling (#50883) by @BlazeSR10hawk * Fix generate for mps and encoder-decoder models (#51032) by @Cyrilvallez * Fix TextStreamer dropping spaces sometimes (#51036) by @Cyrilvallez * Fix long lagging when streaming text without spaces and NJK chars (#36708) by @CNSeniorious000 * Speed up StopStringCriteria init and fix its cache never hitting (#50780) by @TheNetherWatcher ## Continuous batching Continuous batching now works under `torch.inference_mode()` and finds sharded key/value projections under any decoder path. The per-token memory estimate scales with the TP size, warmup handles async and static inputs correctly, and an out-of-bounds error in the top-k processor is fixed. * [CB] Scale the per-token memory estimate by the TP size (#48566) by @qgallouedec * Continuous batching: find the sharded key/value projections under any decoder path (#50366) by @qgallouedec * Fix continuous batching under torch.inference_mode() (#50863) by @tarekziade * [CB] Re-order the warmup block so async warms both sets of inputs (#50868) by @remi-or * Wait for each warmup forward before the next one rewrites the static inputs (#50353) by @qgallouedec * Fix out-of-bounds error in continuous batching top-k processor (#50282) by @khush-patel-09 * [CB] Replace test prompts with less ambiguous ones (#50876) by @remi-or ## Chat templates, parsing and serving Chat parsing gets a new `python-call-list` content parser, better handling of bare keys and duplicate XML arguments, and three further parser fixes. `apply_chat_template` accepts message objects, and assistant masks are correct with left truncation. `transformers serve` handles a missing Hub cache, lists loaded models in `/v1/models`, keeps local paths containing `@`, and keeps assistant content when `tool_calls` is empty. * [Chat Parsing] Add `python-call-list` content parser (#50619) by @nico-martin * [Chat Parsing] Quote bare keys that have whitespace around them with `unquoted_keys` (#50917) by @gagan-baghel * [Chat Parsing] Preserve array values when merging duplicate XML arguments (#50760) by @crunz-ailab * Fix three chat parsing bugs (#50655) by @Rocketknight1 * Fix apply_chat_template with message objects (#50818) by @Rocketknight1 * Fix assistant tokens mask with left truncation (#50758) by @yibol9768-alt * fix(chat templating): isolate concurrent assistant tracking (#50673) by @BlazeSR10hawk * Just a small improvement in jinja (#50635) by @zucchini-nlp * Accept argument types in parentheses in get_json_schema docstrings (#50745) by @miinimal * [serve] Handle missing Hub cache and include loaded models in /v1/models (#50663) by @RyanMullins * [serve] Preserve local model paths containing '@' in ModelManager (#50662) by @RyanMullins * [serve] Keep assistant content when tool_calls is null or empty (#50707) by @AabhasK ## Pipelines Multimodal pipelines now accept media-only inputs and string assistant prefills, keep Mistral prefills in Voxtral, stop mutating generation kwargs, and return chat messages as `input_text` when returning tensors. `pipeline` also respects a `device_map` that targets a single device. * fix(pipelines): support media-only inputs in AnyToAnyPipeline (#50856) by @BlazeSR10hawk * fix(pipelines): support string assistant prefill in multimodal full-t… (#50679) by @BlazeSR10hawk * fix: preserve Mistral prefill in Voxtral and multimodal pipelines (#50624) by @BlazeSR10hawk * fix(pipelines): avoid mutating multimodal generation kwargs (#50786) by @BlazeSR10hawk * Return the chat messages as input_text when multimodal pipelines return tensors (#50816) by @burrows99 * Fix `pipeline` ignoring `device_map` when it targets a single device (#50645) by @wanhakim ## Vision Vision fixes cover Muse Glimmer's embedding order, GotOCR2 and Emu3 image sizes, Kimi video inputs, NemotronH Omni video forwarding, SAM3 RoPE precision in bf16, and DETR-family configs with `dilation=None`. SigLIP2 and LFM2-VL now process all images at once with tensor ops. Flash Attention is turned off for multimodal models whose image mask it would drop. * Fix Muse Glimmer vision embedding order (#50847) by @sid-rp * Fix GotOCR2 image size (#50810) by @guarin * Fix Emu3 image sizes after channel format conversion (#50615) by @stefanielizeth73-art * Kimi video fix (#50633) by @zucchini-nlp * Fix NemotronH_Omni_Reasoning_V3 video forwarding and MTP vision norm weight conversion (#49839) by @meatybobby * Keep SAM3's RoPE positions in fp32 when loading in bf16 (#50938) by @qgallouedec * Fix loading DETR-family configs that store dilation=None (#50934) by @sibisrinivasb * SigLIP2: compute the position-embedding resize for all images with tensor ops (#50736) by @IlyasMoutawwakil * LFM2-VL: run the projector on all images at once (#50734) by @IlyasMoutawwakil * LFM2-VL: integration expectations after #50734 (A10, MI300X) (#50923) by @IlyasMoutawwakil * Turn off Flash Attention support for multimodal models whose image mask it drops (#50724) by @albertvillanova ## Audio Audio fixes cover the OmniASR CTC blank token, Qwen3 Omni audio kwargs, Qwen3-ASR's `truncation=False` default, PeAudioVideo loading with timm 1.0.31, and the audio training examples. * Fix OmniASR CTC blank token ID (#51040) by @taking-lying-flat * Add missing past_key_values deprecation decorator to OmniASRForCondit… (#50983) by @RyanMullins * Fix Qwen3 Omni audio kwargs forwarding (#50616) by @remote-controlled-man * Restore `truncation=False` default for Qwen3-ASR audio (#50740) by @hmellor * Fixes PeAudioVideo model loading with timm 1.0.31. In that version, t… (#50862) by @sywangyi * FIx audio training examples. (#50672) by @ebezzam ## Quantization Dequantized models are now saved without the quantizer's weight conversions, and the unquantized weights of a dequantized FP8 checkpoint are cast to the model's dtype. The quantization docs also get a standard template for each method. * Save dequantized models without the quantizer's weight conversions (#50271) by @qgallouedec * Cast the unquantized weights of a dequantized FP8 checkpoint to the model's dtype (#50595) by @qgallouedec * Update inkling2 quant config (#50829) by @guarin * [docs] Standard template for quantization methods (#50848) by @stevhliu ## Parallelization FSDP2 modules are resharded before the optimizer is created, pipeline parallelism spreads layers more evenly, and TP sharding of tied weights is fixed. * Reshard FSDP2 modules before creating the optimizer (#50535) by @qgallouedec * [perf] Spread layer over PP more evenly (#50693) by @francesco-bertolotti * Fixes an issue related to TP sharding of tied weights (#50272) by @tengomucho ## Exporters Exported ONNX, OpenVINO and ExecuTorch programs load without `trust_remote_code`. release.name: Release v5.24.0
release.body: # Release v5.24.0 ## New Model additions ### Inkling 2 Mini Inkling 2 Mini is a multimodal model from Thinking Machines Lab that accepts text and image inputs and generates text outputs. It is a smaller sibling of Inkling 2 Small, added in v5.23.0. It has 24 decoder layers instead of 48, and compensates with a looping mechanism in which layers 6 to 17 run three times. A learned message-passing mechanism mixes the residuals of the previous pass into the attention and mixture-of-experts inputs of each loop layer. The decoder has a hidden size of 2304 and routes each token to 8 of 128 experts. The image encoder, tokenizer and processor are the same as Inkling 2 Small's. A research checkpoint ([TML-d24-varloop-research](https://huggingface.co/thinkingmachines/TML-d24-varloop-research)) has the same architecture but supports a variable number of loop passes. Fewer passes are faster, and more passes improve quality. Both checkpoints contain NVFP4 and MXFP8 quantized layers, which are dequantized at load time. **Links:** [Documentation](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/inkling2_loop) | [Blog Post](https://thinkingmachines.ai/news/inkling-2-mini/) | [HF Blog Post](https://huggingface.co/blog/inkling2mini) * Add Inkling2 Mini (#51050) by @guarin ### Apertus 1.5 Apertus 1.5 is a multimodal model from the Swiss AI Initiative that accepts text, images and audio and generates text. It extends the Apertus language model with the EMU3.5 vision tokenizer for images and WavTokenizer for audio. The EMU3.5 tokenizer is an image-only VQGAN with the same encoder as Chameleon's, and it assigns codes by the largest inner product with the codebook. The media tokenizers turn images and audio into discrete tokens, which the language backbone processes alongside text in a shared input vocabulary. The output vocabulary contains only text tokens, so image and audio generation are not supported. **Links:** [Documentation](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/apertus1p5) * Apertus 1.5: add model (#47662) by @RaphaelKreft ### WavTokenizer WavTokenizer encodes 24 kHz mono audio into discrete tokens using a single codebook, at 40 or 75 tokens per second depending on the checkpoint, and reconstructs audio from those tokens. `WavTokenizerModel` encodes and decodes, and `WavTokenizerEncoderModel` only encodes. Speech, music/audio and unified checkpoints are available. The 40-token-per-second variant is the audio tokenizer of Apertus 1.5. Training the codec is not supported. **Links:** [Documentation](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/wavtokenizer) | [Paper](https://huggingface.co/papers/2408.16532) * Apertus 1.5: add model (#47662) by @RaphaelKreft ### Dory Dory is a looped (latent-recurrent) language model from NVIDIA. It uses a normalized-GPT architecture with interleaved sliding-window and full attention layers. A shared block of layers is applied repeatedly, so Dory can spend more compute per token. The loop count can be changed at inference time on the same checkpoint to trade speed against quality. **Links:** [Documentation](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/dory) | [Paper (nGPT)](https://huggingface.co/papers/2410.01131) * Add Dory model support (#50099) by @shan18 ### HY4-VL HY4-VL (Hunyuan V4 Vision-Language) combines the HYV4 mixture-of-experts text backbone with a vision encoder for image-text and video-text generation. It supports dynamic-resolution visual inputs and uses multimodal rotary position embeddings (mRoPE) to represent temporal and spatial positions. It builds on the Qwen2-VL design and shares its vision patch merger with HunYuan-VL. **Links:** [Documentation](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/hy_v4_vl) * Add HY4-VL (#50877) by @vasqu ### Omnilingual ASR Omnilingual ASR is a suite of multilingual speech-recognition models from Meta FAIR that covers more than 1,600 languages. Each model pairs a Wav2Vec2-style audio encoder with one of two heads: * **CTC** (`OmniASRForCTC`): a linear projection to the vocabulary, decoded non-autoregressively with greedy CTC. * **Audio language model** (`OmniASRForConditionalGeneration`): audio embeddings are projected into a Llama decoder that generates the transcription. It optionally takes a language code (e.g. `"eng_Latn"`), which generally improves transcription quality. Both variants come in 300M, 1B, 3B and 7B sizes. **Links:** [Documentation](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/omniasr) | [CTC Documentation](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/omniasr_ctc) | [Paper](https://huggingface.co/papers/2511.09690) * Adding Omnilingual ASR models (#43265) by @ebezzam ### Lara Mini Lara Mini is a multilingual base language model from Translated with 7.2B total and 0.6B active parameters per token. It is a hybrid of linear-time recurrent layers, sliding-window attention and a few global attention layers, each followed by a fine-grained mixture of experts. The weights are released under the CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 license (non-commercial use) in a gated repository. **Links:** [Documentation](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/lara_mini) | [Paper](https://huggingface.co/papers/2611.16956) * Add Lara Mini (#50819) by @ValeGian ### SarvamMLA SarvamMLA is the architecture of Sarvam-105B, a 105B-parameter mixture-of-experts language model from Sarvam AI. It combines Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA) with sparse MoE routing: 128 routed experts with 8 active per token, plus 1 shared expert. It uses sigmoid routing with group-based top-k selection and YaRN rotary embeddings for contexts up to 131K tokens. The architecture is the same as DeepSeek-V3, with a custom configuration. **Links:** [Documentation](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/sarvam_mla) * Add SarvamMLA model (sarvamai/sarvam-105b) (#44569) by @aashay-sarvam ### SarvamMoE SarvamMoE is the architecture of Sarvam-30B, Sarvam AI's 30B-parameter mixture-of-experts model. It uses grouped-query attention with QK normalization, and 128 routed experts with 6 active per token, plus 1 shared expert. The architecture is the same as GLM-4-MoE, so the auto classes load it with the GLM-4-MoE implementation and only `SarvamMoEConfig` is specific to SarvamMoE. **Links:** [Documentation](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/sarvam_moe) * Add SarvamMoE (sarvamai/sarvam-30b) (#51023) by @hmellor ### EXAONE EXAONE covers the EXAONE 3.0, EXAONE 3.5 and EXAONE Deep language models from LG AI Research. Their architecture is the same as Llama, so the auto classes load them with `LlamaModel` and `LlamaForCausalLM`, and only `ExaoneConfig` is specific to EXAONE. The released checkpoints are renamed to the Llama names when loading and back when saving, so they no longer need `trust_remote_code=True`. **Links:** [Documentation](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/exaone) * Add EXAONE (#50966) by @hmellor ### Model updates * **Ling 3.1 Flash** now loads natively through `BailingHybrid`, like Ling 3.0 in v5.20.0 (#49737) by @icavan * **Beam** gains a `BeamForTokenClassification` head (#50634) by @AymenKallala ## Breaking changes ### Cache renaming: `past_key_values` / `cache_params` → `cache` (#50585, #50730) `past_key_values` and `cache_params` are renamed to `cache` across the library. The old names still work with a deprecation warning; see the dedicated section below. * 🚨🚨 Rename `past_key_values`/`cache_params` to `cache` (#50585) by @Cyrilvallez * Bump minimal peft version for cache name compatibility (#50730) by @Cyrilvallez Attention models used to call their cache `past_key_values`, while Mamba-style and linear-attention models called it `cache_params`. Hybrid models therefore had to juggle two names for the same object. There is now a single name, `cache`, everywhere: model `forward` signatures, `generate`, `prepare_inputs_for_generation`, the masking utilities, and every `ModelOutput`. ```python # Before outputs = model(input_ids, past_key_values=past_key_values, use_cache=True) next_cache = outputs.past_key_values # Now outputs = model(input_ids, cache=cache, use_cache=True) next_cache = outputs.cache ``` * **Fully backward compatible for now**: `past_key_values=` / `cache_params=` are renamed to `cache` automatically, with a one-time deprecation warning. Model `forward` and `prepare_inputs_for_generation` accept the old names until **v5.40.0**, and `generate` accepts them until **v6.0.0**. Passing both an old name and `cache` raises a `ValueError`. * **Outputs too**: `outputs.past_key_values`, `outputs.cache_params` and `outputs["past_key_values"]` still return the cache. Output classes can also still be built with the old field names (e.g. `CausalLMOutputWithPast(past_key_values=...)`), so most remote-code models keep working unchanged. * **Custom code**: models defined outside the library should rename their arguments to `cache`. Layers now call `cache.update(key_states, value_states, layer_idx, kwargs=kwargs)`, so custom `Cache` subclasses that override `update` should accept the extra `kwargs` argument. 🚨 `peft>=0.22.0` is now required. 📚 Docs: ### Multimodal Outputs Generative multimodal models now return shared output classes (`MultimodalBaseModelOutputWithPast`, `MultimodalCausalLMOutputWithPast`, and their MoE variants) instead of one output class per model. Code that checks for a model-specific output class should switch to these. * 🚨 Multimodal Model Output for generative LMs (#50379) by @zucchini-nlp `modeling_attn_mask_utils.py` has been removed. Every function in it had been deprecated in favor of `transformers.masking_utils`. Remote-code models that still import `_prepare_4d_causal_attention_mask` or `AttentionMaskConverter` from it must move to `transformers.masking_utils`. ### Other things * Remove deprecated and unused older mask API file (#50728) by @Cyrilvallez LayoutLMv3 (and the PP-DocLayoutV2 reading-order model that shares its code) now go through the attention interface, so SDPA and flex attention are supported. The relative position bias is built once per forward pass and passed to attention as `position_bias`. * 🚨 LayoutLMv3: support SDPA through the attention interface, build the relative position bias once (#50688) by @14H034160212 ## Cache Beyond the rename, this release adds static-cache support to assisted decoding and fixes `generate` with flex attention and a static cache. `StaticCache` now allocates values with the value states' dtype, and the cache is kept under activation checkpointing when gradients are off. The `is_linear` / `is_croppable` properties are fixed for hybrid linear/full-attention models, BigBird block-sparse decoding works with a KV cache, and KV sharing is restored for the Gemma 4 assistants. * Support static cache in assisted decoding (#49415) by @jiqing-feng * Simplify cache handling in generate (#50910) by @Cyrilvallez * Fix generate with flex attention and a static cache (#50864) by @tarekziade * Allocate the StaticCache values with the value states' dtype (#49554) by @qgallouedec * Keep the cache under activation checkpointing when gradients are off (#50890) by @qgallouedec * [cache] Fix is_linear property to correctly remove hybrid layers (#51030) by @Cyrilvallez * Fix is_croppable property for mixed linear-full attention classes (#51028) by @Cyrilvallez * Fix BigBird block-sparse decoding with a KV cache (#49984) by @jiqing-feng * fix(gemma4): Restore KV sharing for the Gemma 4 assistants and their targets (#50531) by @harshaljanjani * Fix Dory vocabulary resizing, loop validation, and last-loop static caching (#50982) by @shan18 * Fix device placement in `test_bc_cache_name_{forward,generate}` (#50757) by @ydshieh * Update test_dynamic_cache_hard expected values for A10G (#50822) by @ydshieh ## Generation Generation fixes cover sampled beam search (candidates are sorted again before finalization), constrained sampling (batch IDs are preserved), `generate` on MPS with encoder-decoder models, and `TextStreamer`, which no longer drops spaces or lags on text without spaces such as Chinese, Japanese and Korean. `StopStringCriteria` initializes faster, and its cache now actually hits. * Restore sorting of sampled beam candidates before finalization (#50754) by @BlazeSR10hawk * fix(generate): preserve batch IDs in constrained sampling (#50883) by @BlazeSR10hawk * Fix generate for mps and encoder-decoder models (#51032) by @Cyrilvallez * Fix TextStreamer dropping spaces sometimes (#51036) by @Cyrilvallez * Fix long lagging when streaming text without spaces and NJK chars (#36708) by @CNSeniorious000 * Speed up StopStringCriteria init and fix its cache never hitting (#50780) by @TheNetherWatcher ## Continuous batching Continuous batching now works under `torch.inference_mode()` and finds sharded key/value projections under any decoder path. The per-token memory estimate scales with the TP size, warmup handles async and static inputs correctly, and an out-of-bounds error in the top-k processor is fixed. * [CB] Scale the per-token memory estimate by the TP size (#48566) by @qgallouedec * Continuous batching: find the sharded key/value projections under any decoder path (#50366) by @qgallouedec * Fix continuous batching under torch.inference_mode() (#50863) by @tarekziade * [CB] Re-order the warmup block so async warms both sets of inputs (#50868) by @remi-or * Wait for each warmup forward before the next one rewrites the static inputs (#50353) by @qgallouedec * Fix out-of-bounds error in continuous batching top-k processor (#50282) by @khush-patel-09 * [CB] Replace test prompts with less ambiguous ones (#50876) by @remi-or ## Chat templates, parsing and serving Chat parsing gets a new `python-call-list` content parser, better handling of bare keys and duplicate XML arguments, and three further parser fixes. `apply_chat_template` accepts message objects, and assistant masks are correct with left truncation. `transformers serve` handles a missing Hub cache, lists loaded models in `/v1/models`, keeps local paths containing `@`, and keeps assistant content when `tool_calls` is empty. * [Chat Parsing] Add `python-call-list` content parser (#50619) by @nico-martin * [Chat Parsing] Quote bare keys that have whitespace around them with `unquoted_keys` (#50917) by @gagan-baghel * [Chat Parsing] Preserve array values when merging duplicate XML arguments (#50760) by @crunz-ailab * Fix three chat parsing bugs (#50655) by @Rocketknight1 * Fix apply_chat_template with message objects (#50818) by @Rocketknight1 * Fix assistant tokens mask with left truncation (#50758) by @yibol9768-alt * fix(chat templating): isolate concurrent assistant tracking (#50673) by @BlazeSR10hawk * Just a small improvement in jinja (#50635) by @zucchini-nlp * Accept argument types in parentheses in get_json_schema docstrings (#50745) by @miinimal * [serve] Handle missing Hub cache and include loaded models in /v1/models (#50663) by @RyanMullins * [serve] Preserve local model paths containing '@' in ModelManager (#50662) by @RyanMullins * [serve] Keep assistant content when tool_calls is null or empty (#50707) by @AabhasK ## Pipelines Multimodal pipelines now accept media-only inputs and string assistant prefills, keep Mistral prefills in Voxtral, stop mutating generation kwargs, and return chat messages as `input_text` when returning tensors. `pipeline` also respects a `device_map` that targets a single device. * fix(pipelines): support media-only inputs in AnyToAnyPipeline (#50856) by @BlazeSR10hawk * fix(pipelines): support string assistant prefill in multimodal full-t… (#50679) by @BlazeSR10hawk * fix: preserve Mistral prefill in Voxtral and multimodal pipelines (#50624) by @BlazeSR10hawk * fix(pipelines): avoid mutating multimodal generation kwargs (#50786) by @BlazeSR10hawk * Return the chat messages as input_text when multimodal pipelines return tensors (#50816) by @burrows99 * Fix `pipeline` ignoring `device_map` when it targets a single device (#50645) by @wanhakim ## Vision Vision fixes cover Muse Glimmer's embedding order, GotOCR2 and Emu3 image sizes, Kimi video inputs, NemotronH Omni video forwarding, SAM3 RoPE precision in bf16, and DETR-family configs with `dilation=None`. SigLIP2 and LFM2-VL now process all images at once with tensor ops. Flash Attention is turned off for multimodal models whose image mask it would drop. * Fix Muse Glimmer vision embedding order (#50847) by @sid-rp * Fix GotOCR2 image size (#50810) by @guarin * Fix Emu3 image sizes after channel format conversion (#50615) by @stefanielizeth73-art * Kimi video fix (#50633) by @zucchini-nlp * Fix NemotronH_Omni_Reasoning_V3 video forwarding and MTP vision norm weight conversion (#49839) by @meatybobby * Keep SAM3's RoPE positions in fp32 when loading in bf16 (#50938) by @qgallouedec * Fix loading DETR-family configs that store dilation=None (#50934) by @sibisrinivasb * SigLIP2: compute the position-embedding resize for all images with tensor ops (#50736) by @IlyasMoutawwakil * LFM2-VL: run the projector on all images at once (#50734) by @IlyasMoutawwakil * LFM2-VL: integration expectations after #50734 (A10, MI300X) (#50923) by @IlyasMoutawwakil * Turn off Flash Attention support for multimodal models whose image mask it drops (#50724) by @albertvillanova ## Audio Audio fixes cover the OmniASR CTC blank token, Qwen3 Omni audio kwargs, Qwen3-ASR's `truncation=False` default, PeAudioVideo loading with timm 1.0.31, and the audio training examples. * Fix OmniASR CTC blank token ID (#51040) by @taking-lying-flat * Add missing past_key_values deprecation decorator to OmniASRForCondit… (#50983) by @RyanMullins * Fix Qwen3 Omni audio kwargs forwarding (#50616) by @remote-controlled-man * Restore `truncation=False` default for Qwen3-ASR audio (#50740) by @hmellor * Fixes PeAudioVideo model loading with timm 1.0.31. In that version, t… (#50862) by @sywangyi * FIx audio training examples. (#50672) by @ebezzam ## Quantization Dequantized models are now saved without the quantizer's weight conversions, and the unquantized weights of a dequantized FP8 checkpoint are cast to the model's dtype. The quantization docs also get a standard template for each method. * Save dequantized models without the quantizer's weight conversions (#50271) by @qgallouedec * Cast the unquantized weights of a dequantized FP8 checkpoint to the model's dtype (#50595) by @qgallouedec * Update inkling2 quant config (#50829) by @guarin * [docs] Standard template for quantization methods (#50848) by @stevhliu ## Parallelization FSDP2 modules are resharded before the optimizer is created, pipeline parallelism spreads layers more evenly, and TP sharding of tied weights is fixed. * Reshard FSDP2 modules before creating the optimizer (#50535) by @qgallouedec * [perf] Spread layer over PP more evenly (#50693) by @francesco-bertolotti * Fixes an issue related to TP sharding of tied weights (#50272) by @tengomucho ## Exporters Exported ONNX, OpenVINO and ExecuTorch programs load without `trust_remote_code`. rawIngestions.titleRaw: huggingface/transformers v5.23.0 released
rawIngestions.contentRaw: # Release v5.23.0 ## New Model additions ### Inkling2 Inkling 2 Small is a multimodal model from Thinking Machines Lab that accepts text and image inputs and generates text outputs, and it is intended for use in English and other languages and across multiple coding languages. Its language backbone has 48 mixture-of-experts decoder layers, each routing tokens to 8 of 384 experts, for 594B total and 17B active parameters. It keeps the Inkling decoder (learned relative attention, short causal convolutions, mixture-of-experts layers) and adds block attention residuals, gated attention with a learned sink, and dynamic key/value convolutions. Images are encoded by a Perception Encoder-based vision transformer and projected into the language model embeddings, one embedding per 40x40 pixel patch. **Links:** [Documentation](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/inkling2) | [Blog Post](https://thinkingmachines.ai/news/inkling-2-small/) * Add inkling2 (#50682) by @guarin in [#50682](https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/pull/50682) ### JEV JEV is a decision head that scores single-token labels with a linear layer at the last token of the prompt, soft-capped like the logits of a language model head. `JevForDecision` is the model of the checkpoint and its head, and it reads the head files shipped next to the weights (`head.safetensors` and `judge_config.json` for JEV). The same head is also used by GEV and reads the 255 answer codes of pplx-decider and d3, and it can be run through the experimental `decision` pipeline or directly with `decide`. **Note:** JEV and the decision pipeline are currently experimental. Their APIs, configuration, and behavior may change as development continues. They should be used with caution in production environments. **Links:** [Documentation](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/jev) * Add Jev + decision core (#50054) by @ArthurZucker in [#50054](https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/pull/50054) ### LFM3 LFM3 is the third generation of Liquid Foundation Models from Liquid AI. Like LFM2, it is a hybrid architecture that combines gated short convolutions with grouped-query attention, with the attention layers split between full-attention and sliding-window layers. The attention layers apply RMSNorm to the query and key heads and gate their output with a per-head sigmoid. Every layer applies a sandwich norm to the operator and feed-forward outputs before the residual addition. **Links:** [Documentation](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/lfm3) * [Model] LFM3 Family: LFM3-Text (#50322) by @paulpak58 in [#50322](https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/pull/50322) ### Dots 3 Note Preview Dots 3 Note Preview is a mixture-of-experts causal language model that accepts native text, image, video, and audio inputs. It uses a shared vision encoder for images and videos and a Whisper-style audio encoder, and both encoders project their outputs into the language model's hidden space before autoregressive text generation. BF16 and FP8 inference are supported. **Links:** [Documentation](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/dots3_note) * Add dots3-note Preview model support (#47844) by @miraclezqc in [#47844](https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/pull/47844) ### LFM3-VL LFM3-VL is a vision-language model family from Liquid AI, built on the LFM3 language model. It takes images and videos at their native resolution together with text. It combines a hybrid vision encoder (a linear patchifier, gated depthwise 2D convolution layers, and bidirectional grouped-query attention layers with 2D rotary embeddings) with a projector and an LFM3 language model. The projector merges each 2x2 block of patch features into one language token through a layer norm and a two-layer MLP. **Links:** [Documentation](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/lfm3_vl) * [Model] LFM3 Family: LFM3-VL (#50392) by @paulpak58 in [#50392](https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/pull/50392) ### IQuestCoder IQuest-Coder-V1 is a family of code language models developed by IQuest Lab, available in 7B, 14B and 40B sizes with base, instruct and thinking variants. Its architecture is the same as Llama, so the Transformers auto classes load it with LlamaModel and LlamaForCausalLM, and only IQuestCoderConfig is specific to IQuestCoder. The looped `IQuest-Coder-V1-*-Loop-*` checkpoints use a different architecture and aren't supported. **Links:** [Documentation](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/iquestcoder) * Add IQuestCoder (#50579) by @hmellor in [#50579](https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/pull/50579) ### InternLM3 InternLM3 is an 8B instruction-tuned language model developed by Shanghai AI Laboratory (checkpoint: internlm/internlm3-8b-instruct). Its architecture is the same as Llama, so the auto classes load it with the Llama implementation (LlamaModel and LlamaForCausalLM), and only InternLM3Config is specific to InternLM3. The config names the attention biases `qkv_bias` and the output projection and MLP biases `bias`. InternLM3Config loads these as `attention_bias` and `mlp_bias` and requires them to be equal, as they are in the released checkpoints. **Links:** [Documentation](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/internlm3) * Add InternLM3 (#50578) by @hmellor in [#50578](https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/pull/50578) ## Breaking changes * 🚨 Remove the `ep_router` expert-parallel style (#49615) by @IlyasMoutawwakil * 🚨 Run MXFP4 GPT-OSS experts through `ep_dispatch_experts` (#49613) by @IlyasMoutawwakil * 🚨 `deepgemm_megamoe` EP implementation for DeepGEMM Mega MoE (#49606) by @IlyasMoutawwakil * 🚨 Slim down `[audio]` to torchaudio + soundfile + soxr (drop librosa and phonemizer) (#50610) by @eustlb * 🚨 Deprecate Wav2Vec2ProcessorWithLM and pyctcdecode/kenlm LM decoding (#50408) by @eustlb * 🚨 Exporters: `ExportedModel`, Hub save/load, one backend registry (#50029) by @IlyasMoutawwakil * 🚨 Move processing defaults to class (#49089) by @guarin * :rotating_light: [`kernels`] Bump version (#50307) by @vasqu * :rotating_light: Finally drop rope deltas from ModelOutput! (#50153) by @zucchini-nlp * 🚨 Safe-ize pi0 graphs (#50160) by @molbap * 🚨 [serve][breaking] update attn for mac users (#49730) by @SunMarc * 🚨 build and expand once the tp/ep_plan/fsdp_plan (#49527) by @3outeille ## Exporters: export, share and run any model on its backend (#50029, #50032, #50309, #50311) https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/2b17b2ab-b2b8-4e34-a983-4a7177330e4e Every export now returns an `ExportedModel`. You call it like the original model (same kwargs, same output class), push it to the Hub, and load it back on the backend's own runtime. The same API covers Dynamo, ONNX Runtime, OpenVINO and ExecuTorch. ```python from transformers import AutoModel, AutoTokenizer from transformers.exporters import ExportedModel, OnnxConfig, OnnxExporter model = AutoModel.from_pretrained("google/embeddinggemma-2") tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained("google/embeddinggemma-2") inputs = tokenizer(["Exporters are here!"], return_tensors="pt") exported = OnnxExporter().export(model, inputs, OnnxConfig(dynamic=True, ort_fusions="cuda")) exported.push_to_hub("my-org/embeddinggemma-2-onnx") exported_model = ExportedModel.from_pretrained("my-org/embeddinggemma-2-onnx", device="cuda") outputs = exported_model(**inputs) # same output class as model(**inputs) ``` - **Fused for the runtime**: `OnnxConfig(ort_fusions="cpu" | "cuda" | "webgpu" | "dml")` rewrites the graph into ONNX Runtime's fused transformer ops at export time: attention, `GroupQueryAttention` over the KV cache, rotary, norms and `MoE`. OpenVINO exports now hit OpenVINO's fused CPU kernels for attention, RoPE, MoE experts and compressed int8/int4 weights, which makes decode 2.4–3.9× faster than before. - **Faster than `torch.compile`**: on EmbeddingGemma2 (8 × 128 tokens), ONNX Runtime with the TensorRT EP is 7.6× faster than eager PyTorch and 1.4× faster than `torch.compile` on an A100. OpenVINO is 4.1× faster than eager and 2.2× faster than `torch.compile` on a Xeon Platinum 8570 (4.9× and 2.6× with int8 weights). - **Shareable**: an export saves and loads like a model, optionally in a `subfolder` of the model repo. Its `export.json` records the config, input shapes, package versions and I/O names. Quantized exports (PT2E, NNCF, ONNX Runtime) save and run the same way. 🚨 `export()` returns an `ExportedModel`, and an ONNX program is an `onnx_ir.Model`. `OnnxConfig`'s and `OpenVINOConfig`'s `output_path` options are gone in favour of `save_pretrained`. Custom backends register with `register_backend`. 📚 Docs: https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/exporters ## Vision This release fixes a range of vision-model bugs: classification pipelines now respect `problem_type`, and several models get corrected behavior (Step3.7 RoPE axis order, MiniMax-M3-VL packed attention isolation, Qwen VL positions with reused caches, PaddleOCR-VL interpolation alignment, Kosmos2 SDPA masking, and Emu3 float image handling). Chunked prefill now keeps image inputs on the * fix(pipelines): respect problem_type in image and video classification pipelines (#50582) by @surendra902 in [#50582] * Fix Step3.7 vision RoPE spatial W/H axis order (#50547) by @caohch-1 in [#50547] * Raise ValueError for out-of-range float images in convert_to_rgb (#50487) by @n24q02m in [#50487] * CI: install OpenVINO and NNCF in the daily GPU image (#50422) by @IlyasMoutawwakil in [#50422] * Fix MiniMax-M3-VL packed vision attention isolation (#50346) by @taking-lying-flat in [#50346] * Fix Qwen VL positions when a text cache is reused with a new image (#50427) by @Arnav66692 in [#50427] * [Docker] Update Nvidia CI and Flash Attn CI images to torch 2.15 / cu132 (#50467) by @ydshieh in [#50467] * Fix PaddleOCR-VL vision position interpolation alignment (#50384) by @scyyh11 in [#50384] * Fix Emu3 image processor crash on float numpy images (#50226) by @simpleqt in [#50226] * Build Idefics-style vision position ids with torch.where (#49917) by @shoumikhin in [#49917] * Keep image inputs on the first chunk of a chunked prefill (#49753) by @digit50 in [#49753] * Docs: note in the v5 migration guide that hidden_states[-1] of vision models is pre-norm (#50303) by @ravediamond in [#50303] * Remove the GitHub API cache-bust from the AMD docker images (#49351) by @tarekziade in [#49351] * [docs] Vision backend differences (#50131) by @stevhliu in [#50131] * [Kosmos2] Fix SDPA applying a causal mask in the image-to-text projection (#50118) by @tarekziade in [#50118] ## Parallelization This release improves distributed training and inference. Expert parallelism gains a selectable `ep_implementation` (all-reduce for CUDA-graph-friendly inference, all-to-all for training). The Trainer now reduces FSDP/HSDP gradients only on the last micro-batch, and the token-count normalization is fixed to use true division.
